### Added

- (models) [Use shared credential operations for every model](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3530) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — Connecting Claude or Gemini on Vertex takes a service-account JSON file on the credential form, titled `Upload service account credentials`, and every model's key, the platform's too, is entered and replaced on that form. New model fills in the technical name from a display name.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.41.1...v3.42.0
